name: After § 51
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section II – European Council and Council
part_text: 51 a. emphasises that health and safety at work, including psychosocial risks (stress, burnout, harassment), is a priority; calls on the Secretariat to officially recognise psychosocial risks as occupational risks and to adopt a Secretariat-wide prevention plan with measurable targets; calls for the introduction of risk assessments covering remote working, missions and tight deadlines, as well as confidential reporting channels, training for managers and regular social dialogue; insists on the enforcement of the right to disconnect;
